data.description: The protagonist, Lee Hansoo, finally reached the boss stage after nine years of playing the game "Dungeon and Stone", which no one had been able to clear until now. However, just as he entered the boss room, he saw a notification alerting him that he had cleared the tutorial and that he had possessed the body of the barbarian, Bjorn Jandel, who was a playable character in the game. In the world of "Dungeon and Stone", only one city remained standing after the destruction of the world. A labyrinth would open every month, offering explorers a chance to clear it for rewards. In this world where barbarians are seen as useless in everything but battle, a barbarian who does not fight will not be able to survive. If one cannot pay the outrageous taxes demanded by the city, the only fate that awaits is a downgrade in status to a 'lower-class citizen'. If it is revealed that you are possessing the character you are playing, you will be named an "evil spirit" and killed. The only way for Lee Hansoo to survive is to enter the labyrinth and fight while risking his life. With the skills he has accumulated over nine years of gameplay and a stupidly strong barbarian physique, he strives to survive in this game...

data.title: The Regressor and the Blind Saint
data.description:
Bera, once a beggar, would trample over others and resort to even the most despicable deals if it means he'd stay alive.

Even in an age when the Demon King appeared, he never fought like a hero. Instead, he hid himself in the deepest darkness, doing nothing but preserving his own life. He survived to the very end, only to find that his reward after the war was karma.

As he lay waiting for death, consumed by a curse, Bera had no desire for anyone to stand by his side in his final moments. He believed that, in the end, there would be no one left beside him anyway.

Yet when he opened his eyes, he found himself in a filthy gutter... and there stood Renée, the blind Saintess who had been declared dead.

Blind and covered in burn scars, Renée had a wretched appearance, yet she took Bera in with a kindness and selflessness greater than anyone else's... but in the end, she died, and Bera was powerless to stop it.

After regressing, he vowed that this time, he would seek her out first and protect her at all costs. However, protecting Renée cannot be accomplished simply by becoming stronger.

On the day the Saintess's sacred stigmata manifested, the Holy State, the Empire, the Alliance of Kingdoms, the Draconians, and the Followers of the Night all began to move around her, setting the entire continent into motion.
data.author: Papapa
